crossRefs.note: Therefore select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may…
These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip…
They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.
All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.
But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing…
He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;
For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ…
‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will…
Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.
Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,
while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant…
The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs…

people.name: Stephen
people.line: One of seven deacons, full of faith, performed miracles, martyred.

translations.web: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.
translations.bsb: Now Stephen, who was full of grace and power, was performing great wonders and signs among the people.
translations.kjv: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.
translations.asv: And Stephen, full of grace and power, wrought great wonders and signs among the people.
